posts.content: 培訓頁面：Gracent 免費網上研討會，2026 年 11 月 24 日美中時間 8:00–9:00，線上直播。
posts.title: From Burnout to Balance: Mindfulness Practices for BCBAs, SLPs, and OTs in Leadership

summary_en: A free 60-minute live webinar from Gracent (via BehaviorLive), presented by Dr. Paula Kenyon (BCBA-D). It defines burnout and its three dimensions, offers a behavioral analysis of avoidance in aversive work environments, and presents mindfulness as a learnable repertoire, reviewing current evidence including a 2024 systematic review of 49 randomized controlled trials. Participants take part in two brief guided practices and leave with concrete strategies to embed mindfulness into the workday and at home. Held Tuesday 24 November 2026, 08:00-09:00 Central Time (22:00-23:00 Hong Kong/Macau time), fully online, free of charge, in English, with advance registration required. Offers 1 BACB general CE and 0.1 ASHA CE. Aimed at BCBAs, speech-language pathologists, occupational therapists and clinical leaders.
summary_zh: Gracent（經 BehaviorLive）免費 60 分鐘網上研討會，由 Paula Kenyon 博士（BCBA-D）主講。講解倦怠三個面向、逃避行為喺厭惡工作環境入面點樣被負強化維持，以及正念作為一種可以學習嘅注意能力，並回顧最新實證，包括 2024 年 49 項隨機對照試驗嘅系統回顧。參加者會參與兩節簡短引導練習，並帶走將正念融入工作日同屋企嘅具體策略。2026 年 11 月 24 日（星期二）美中時間 8:00–9:00 舉行（香港／澳門時間同日晚上 10:00–11:00），全程線上直播，費用全免，全程英語，須預先報名。可獲 1 BACB 學分及 0.1 ASHA 學分。對象為行為分析師、言語治療師、職能治療師及臨床團隊領導者。
supervision_questions: 你團隊入面嘅倦怠，有幾多係個人因素、有幾多係環境因素？下次督導你會點樣分開兩者嚟傾？
你自己每日有冇一個可以固定做嘅簡短正念練習？如果冇，邊一個時段最容易插入？
